summary: A 72-year-old North Pole man was arrested Tuesday afternoon on a domestic violence assault charge and taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center; the arrest was posted by troopers on Tuesday evening and no court file had been opened in his name by early Wednesday. Fairbanks Police recorded no incidents or arrests on their daily bulletin for either Monday or Tuesday, and no new criminal case was filed in any of the four Interior courts after Tuesday afternoon. The court's weekly criminal filings report, now covering Oct. 28 to Nov. 3, lists 38 cases filed at Fairbanks, four at Nenana, two at Delta Junction and none at Healy; it now includes 4FA-26-02222CR, a Fairbanks case the previous week's report omitted. Twelve open cases carry a hearing on Wednesday. The court's weekly dispositions report has not been updated since Nov. 2 and the U.S. Attorney's press release index could not be read.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest: Francis Baillargeon Jr.
body: Francis Baillargeon Jr., 72, of North Pole was arrested on charges of assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing physical injury to another person — and violation of conditions of release. Troopers record the case as domestic violence related. North Pole, Nov. 3 at about 2:21 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers, case AK26108887.

Troopers say they responded to an address in North Pole for a reported domestic assault and that the investigation determined he had assaulted another person and violated his conditions of release. He was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
No court file had been opened in his name in any Alaska court as of early Nov. 4, so no charge classification comes from the court record. He is arrested, not convicted.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 3

entries.title: Twelve hearings set in Interior courts Wednesday, including a jury trial
body: Twelve open criminal cases in the Fairbanks, Nenana and Delta Junction courts carry a hearing calendared for Wednesday, Nov. 4.

A jury trial in a 2024 Delta Junction case, 4DJ-24-00006CR, is set for 9:15 a.m. in Courtroom 402 at the Fairbanks courthouse; a jury-trial row for the same case at the Delta Junction courthouse that day is recorded as calendared in error. Four bail hearings are set for the morning, one of them, in 4FA-26-02214CR, on an application filed by the prosecution. Five arraignments are set for 1:30 p.m., a status hearing in a Nenana case for 3:00 p.m. and a further bail hearing for 3:30 p.m.
Results are not available at the time of publication.

entries.title: Two Delta Junction case numbers in the court's weekly report cannot be looked up in the court's own database
body: Two criminal case numbers printed in the Alaska Court System's weekly criminal filings report, 4DJ-26-00067CR and 4DJ-26-00068CR, return “No Records Found” in CourtView, the court system's public case database.

The report lists each with one count recorded as a charging document pending or not filed, no degree of offense, and an offense location of Delta Junction. One of the two, 4DJ-26-00068CR, was readable in the database on the evening of Nov. 3, when it recorded a case opened and closed the same day with an entry stating that no complaint or citation was filed. It was no longer served by the database the following morning.
No offense or charge is stated on either file by any court record, and no explanation for the numbers' absence from the database is given by the court.
